decisions.reason: The XL package is a low-cost tier extension of the established anamnesis app that serves large practices. In a growing industry, a firm with slack from a broad installed base has no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search to drop it.

The dedicated support service for dental assistants builds directly on the firm's core strength in customer service and was prominently presented. It strengthens retention of the installed base, so it meets aspirations and gives no reason to reallocate its resources.
